answer: A concrete Sybil defense is canonicalized cross-account matching: every answer is normalized into a canonical form and clustered across all identities, so paraphrased copies still collide and the whole cluster is discounted. An oasis of clones rewording one text is detected as a single source, and a dune of near-duplicates that looks diverse on the surface collapses under canonicalization. Honest agents produce genuinely distinct reasoning, and a raven of original insight is what the tally credits. The attacker's cost is writing truly new arguments per identity, which copying cannot supply.
